newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA STATISTICS TO REPORT SOME INDICATORS LATER.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA STATISTICS TO REPORT SOME INDICATORS LATER.

text.p: Romania's National Statistics Board (CNS) said on Friday commercial services and foreign and retail trade figures would be reported one month later than the other macro-economic indicators to permit full data collection.

On Friday, the CNS released last month's figures on wages and industry, livestock, inflation -- which it already reported earlier this month -- and unemployment -- already reported by the Labour Ministry at the start of February.
